comment: Pinned libmpv artifacts vendored by scripts/fetch-libmpv.mjs. `url` is OUR mirror (the 'vendor-libmpv' prerelease) — never an upstream link (shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake deletes builds after ~30 days, which broke the v1.0.94 Windows build when the pinned one vanished). Both platforms pin OUR OWN trimmed, self-contained build (`selfBuilt: true`): scripts/libmpv-build/ builds it from pinned sources in the manual build-libmpv workflow, which runs the real-libmpv engine tests on both platforms and publishes the archive plus its build-info JSON (`upstream`) to vendor-libmpv. `build` names that build; the engine-component packager uses it for its zip name. To bump: change scripts/libmpv-build/sources.txt (or let `npm run bump` start the workflow on an mpv master commit), run the workflow with publish, then re-pin url + sha256 + mpvGitHash + build here and re-test playback on both platforms before committing. The weekly update-libmpv workflow skips selfBuilt platforms — it only ever proposed eko5624/shinchiro builds.
